description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Duties & Functions delegated to the State Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations w.e.f. 23.08.2016
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (W. D. J. Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations) AND provides detailed portfolio responsibilities through the delegation of functions to another minister. The schedule contains specific duties, functions, departments, and laws to be implemented, which constitutes detailed subject matter responsibility. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it contains both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
